n180e678170.headline: ‘Food inflation spike cause for concern’
n180e678170.summary: A Famine Early Warning Systems report on Southern Africa says high food inflation in Zimbabwe is a major concern. Food makes up a third or more of household expenses.
n180e678170.why: Food inflation erodes household purchasing power and influences central bank policy and the outlook for consumer-facing businesses.

n1ed6c0623d.headline: Armenia finance minister: National debt of more than $10 billion is safe
n1ed6c0623d.summary: Armenia's finance minister said national debt of more than $10 billion is safe, stressing that the relative amount to GDP is the important measure.
n1ed6c0623d.why: Public debt sustainability relative to GDP shapes sovereign credit ratings and borrowing costs for a country.

n627dbee997.headline: East Africa: Kenya
n627dbee997.summary: Kenya has started a series of measures to revitalise cargo business at its ports. The move responds to competition from the port of Dar es Salaam in Tanzania.
n627dbee997.why: Port competitiveness determines trade flows for landlocked East African economies. Cargo volumes at ports drive logistics revenues and regional trade costs.

n3d370a04d5.headline: World Bank warns oil price could soar to record $150 a barrel
n3d370a04d5.summary: The World Bank warned that an escalation of the Israel-Hamas war into a Middle East-wide conflict would disrupt oil supplies and stoke food prices. It cited a possible record oil price of $150 a barrel.
n3d370a04d5.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender that publishes global commodity price forecasts, which investors watch for signals on inflation and energy costs.
n3d370a04d5.why_moved: The warning links a wider Middle East war to supply disruption, a mechanism that can push crude prices higher.

n962648d016.why: GoTo is a major Indonesian internet company that operates ride-hailing and digital payments in Southeast Asia. Its losses and path to profitability are closely watched by investors in regional tech.
